source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U15: Separate execution powers, certificate correction, review and appellate relief

payload.title: Use the remedy that matches the alleged error
payload.core_explanation_md:
The Recovery Officer executes the certificate through the stated recovery powers; that role is not a new merits trial of the debt amount. A clerical or mathematical mistake in the certificate goes through the Presiding Officer correction route. An error said to be apparent, an appealable determination and a complaint about an execution order are different grounds with different procedures.

Execution includes statutory safeguards. A power mentioning detention should not become imprisonment merely because a debtor is poor. A section 30 challenge to the Recovery Officer order and its applicable deposit rule must be distinguished from the separate appeal against the original Tribunal determination. Identify the order, applicant and trigger before calculating any period or deposit.

self_check.prompt_text: Should every dispute be sent to the Recovery Officer for a fresh liability decision?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Match the issue to correction, review, appeal or execution jurisdiction.

payload.stem_md: The certificate transposes two digits in an amount. The branch privately edits the signed certificate and sends it for recovery. What is required?

options.text_md: Private editing is sufficient if the intended amount seems obvious
options.explanation_md: The official certificate must use the competent correction process.

options.text_md: The borrower automatically owes the higher of both figures
options.explanation_md: An error does not create a new liability rule.

options.text_md: Seek correction through the competent Presiding Officer route
options.explanation_md: Clerical correction is distinct from private alteration or retrial.

options.text_md: Ask the Recovery Officer to disregard every certificate requirement
options.explanation_md: Execution still depends on the valid statutory instrument.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Clerical correction is distinct from private alteration or retrial.

payload.stem_md: A debtor lacks means to pay. A note treats detention as automatic solely from poverty. Which concern must be addressed?

options.text_md: Poverty alone always proves wilful refusal
options.explanation_md: Inability and wilful failure despite means are different facts.

options.text_md: The applicable statutory and constitutional safeguards for coercive recovery
options.explanation_md: The existence of a power does not establish lawful use in every file.

options.text_md: The market price of a neighbouring property
options.explanation_md: Unrelated value does not establish the debtor ability or lawful grounds.

options.text_md: The claimant preference is the only required evidence

payload.correct_explanation_md: The existence of a power does not establish lawful use in every file.
